justification: A is a dense field of small pictographic signs in horizontal registers, with birds and body parts appearing only as miniature repeated symbols, while B is a single large composite figure — a bird-headed, winged anthropomorph in profile stride, holding a bucket and raised object beside a stylized plant with rosette-like blossoms. The only real correspondence is generic (profile birds, profile limbs, shallow relief on a wall); the relationships, scale of figures, and compositional logic (text-like registers vs one dominant narrative figure) are quite different.
